question: Compare total 2018 revenues and grants in Table 7.1 with total expenditures in Table 7.2. Which is larger and by how many trillion dong? Do not infer a national fiscal balance from these differently scoped tables.
answer:
According to Table 7.1, total 2018 revenues and grants were 1,364 trillion dong. [p199-table-7.1]

According to Table 7.2, total 2018 expenditures were 1,435 trillion dong. [p200-table-7.2]

Total expenditures are larger than total revenues and grants by 71 trillion dong. [p199-table-7.1] [p200-table-7.2]
